description: Paid ($0.001/call): Persistent key-value memory for agents, scoped to the paying wallet. Your x402 payment IS your authentication: the wallet that pays owns the namespace. No signup, no API keys. Exact-key storage for structured state. For retrieval by MEANING rather than key, use the catalog slugs memory-remember and memory-recall (on MCP, through catalog.call with that slug).

delete.description: Set true to delete the key instead

owner.description: Optional 0x namespace to write into (requires a readwrite grant)

requestId.description: Optional client id for this write; a retry with the same id returns the first answer

ttlSeconds.description: Optional: auto-expire the key after N seconds

name: memory.write
title: Memory write
